retrieval_text:
INCIDENT TYPE:
SUPPLY CHAIN ATTACK

DESCRIPTION:
A supply chain attack compromises trusted software, hardware, vendors, or service providers to gain access to target organizations. These attacks often affect multiple victims simultaneously and can remain undetected for extended periods.

THREAT FRAMEWORK:
- MITRE ATT&CK | T1195 | Supply Chain Compromise

INDICATORS:
- Unexpected software behavior
- Suspicious updates
- Unauthorized code execution
- Vendor-related anomalies
- Compromised software packages

DETECTION RULES:
- Unexpected software modifications
- Suspicious update behavior
- Integrity verification failures

AFFECTED ASSETS:
- Endpoints
- Servers
- Software repositories
title: SUPPLY CHAIN ATTACK
